status: analysis and authority rules frozen; device-specific numerical fields require blinded pilot calibration

hypotheses.primaryNull: one frozen conventional model predicts the orientation-odd coherent-transfer statistic in both +Phi and -Phi configurations within the preregistered covariance budget
hypotheses.primaryAlternative: a configuration-odd residual remains after the frozen conventional model, declared nuisance projection and multiplicity correction
hypotheses.notTested: the experiment does not directly test E8, Spin(2,3), an aether, gravity or a new fundamental interaction

channels.lock: estimated common detuning from common-mode heterodyne quadratures
channels.innovation: full estimator residual retained for bias, autocorrelation and configuration-dependence tests
channels.safety: applied command, saturation, slew, optical power and thermal limits

firewalls: science statistic is not available to either controller during acquisition
phase label is withheld from nuisance-model fitting after calibration freeze
Q and R may not be inflated after unblinding
applied rather than requested commands are logged
abort data are retained and classified rather than silently dropped
requiredMeasuredFields: device identifier, cut, geometry and domain map
discrete F,G and zero-order-hold validation residual
process and detector covariance estimates Q,R
actuator magnitude, slew, delay and hysteresis
mode linewidths, detunings and complex pairwise couplings
thermal, photorefractive and pyroelectric relaxation curves
detector linearity, clipping, phase reference and transfer function

design.unit: one randomized +Phi/-Phi block on one device after lock qualification
design.randomization: balanced blocked random order generated before unblinding
design.blinding: analysis receives opaque configuration labels until calibration, exclusions and nuisance model are frozen
negativeControls: open one coupling to destroy loop closure
reverse port labels in analysis and hardware where possible
inject a known synthetic detector phase
design.replication: repeat the frozen protocol on a second independently characterized device

primaryStatistic.definition: calibration-fixed weighted difference of forward and reverse complex transfer that changes sign under Phi reversal
primaryStatistic.covariance: one shared covariance model estimated from calibration and negative controls
primaryStatistic.test: two-sided configuration-odd contrast with familywise alpha 0.01
primaryStatistic.multiplicity: Holm correction across any preregistered secondary quadratures or frequency bins

qualificationRules: closed-loop poles and delay margin satisfy the frozen robust-stability budget
lock RMS is below the calibration-fixed fraction of the narrowest linewidth
saturation and slew-limit occupancy are below frozen limits
innovation mean and lag tests pass on calibration data
observability and controllability smallest singular values exceed the frozen conditioning floor
abortRules: loss of phase reference or clock synchronization
unlogged actuator clipping or thermal safety intervention
mode crossing invalidates the frozen state labeling
innovation excursion crosses the calibration-fixed safety threshold
device damage or irreversible drift beyond the declared recovery window
exclusionPolicy: Only predeclared safety and acquisition-integrity exclusions are allowed. All excluded blocks, reasons and labels remain in the audit record.
interpretationLadder: estimator failure: reopen identification without inspecting the blinded statistic
conventional closure: validated relational photonic controller
independent replicated residual: qualified new-physics investigation, not discovery
hardwareBoundary: Numerical thresholds, weights and sample size cannot be honestly frozen until pilot measurements provide device covariance, effect scale, bandwidth and safety limits. The rules that derive and freeze them are fixed here.
